title: A test double captures emitted lines for assertion without touching stdout
asA: test author verifying that the application emits the expected log lines during a test
iWant: a test double the factory produces that captures emitted lines in memory instead of writing to stdout
soThat: assertions on log emissions do not depend on stdout capture and do not pollute test output

acceptanceCriteria.description: The blueprint's guide names an in-memory capture mode of the factory contract that returns an ordered array of the emitted structured objects; the capture mode is a documented API of TAC-1601 and can be constructed in a test without any stdout redirection.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a test that constructs the factory in capture mode
acceptanceCriteria.when: the code under test emits any number of log lines
acceptanceCriteria.then: the returned array contains one entry per emission with the same object shape the runtime writes to stdout, and stdout carries no line
